arabic text: VI CHORA TERA HEY AKBAR KIVEIN BULAAVANGI\nTERI JUDAI NU VEERAN MEIN SEYNAN PAAVANGI
english translation text: Akbar, how will I endure this separation from you? I\nwill carry the pain of your absence within my heart.

arabic text: TERE PEYRAN DE NISHAAN TAK KE HUN TAYIN TE MEIN\nJUNDIYAN\nHAI VEER EY VI JE MITGAEY MEIN MAR HI JAAVANGI
english translation text: Until now I have lived by looking at\nthe marks of your footsteps. Brother, if even\nthese are erased, I will surely die.

arabic text: HAI AUN DA JE VATNAAN NU VAADA KITA NA TU POORA\nTE FEYR SOWCH LAEY AKBAR MEIN JEENA PAAVANGI
english translation text: You did not fulfil your promise to return home. Think,\nAkbar—how will I now be able to go on living?

arabic text: HASRAT HEY MERI CHAN AKBAR JADON TERI SHAADI\nHOVEGI\nMEIN SONA SEHRA TERE SIR UTTHE SAJAAVANGI
english translation text: My moon-like Akbar, I longed for the day\nof your wedding, when I would place\na golden wedding crown upon your head.

arabic text: JAANE KIDI EY NAZAR LAGI MERE VEER TURGAYE\nSAREY\nMEIN SOWCHEYA SI KE ASGHAR NU RAJ KHADAAVANGI
english translation text: Who cast an evil eye upon us, that\nall my brothers departed? I had thought I\nwould lovingly feed little Asghar to his fill.

arabic text: MERA VEER JO MILAADE VEY US DI JANNAT DI KHUD\nZAAMIN\nDE HAAR E HASHR DE BARKE FIDA MEIN AAVANGI
english translation text: Whoever reunites me with my brother—God Himself will guarantee\nParadise for that person. On the Day of Judgement,\nI will come carrying a garland of devotion.
